raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Enroll five NVIDIA CI steps in automatic runtime sharding, selecting long jobs from the [duration ranking](https://vllm-ci-dashboard.vercel.app/jobs) over the preceding 12 hours. Batch 3 of five independently based changes.

## Claims

Preserve the test commands and discovery scope while assigning tests using main timing data. Existing AMD fixed shards retain their effective commands and parallelism. Actual wall-time and cost improvements await Buildkite validation.

| Step | 12h median job min | Planned shards | Estimated test min/shard |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `entrypoints-integration-api-server-openai-chat_completion` | 27.5 | 2 | 13.6, 13.5 |
| `lm-eval-small-models-1xb200` | 27.1 | 2 | 13.5, 13.3 |
| `lm-eval-large-models-4xh100` | 26.6 | 2 | 21.2, 4.6 |
| `multi-modal-models-standard-2-qwen3-gemma` | 26.3 | 2 | 12.9, 12.8 |
| `basic-models-tests-other` | 25.1 | 2 | 15.8, 9.1 |


## Validation

- `pre-commit run --files <changed YAML files>`: passed.
- `pytest buildkite/tests/pipeline_generator/test_runtime_shard.py -q` in ci-infra: 24 passed.
- `runtime_shard.plan_step` previews: all five steps produce multiple shards.
- YAML semantic comparison: exactly five enrollments, unchanged commands except NVIDIA fixed-shard arguments, preserved AMD commands and parallelism.
- Buildkite results: current build links, shard/plugin verification, coverage, wall time and cost are in the live validation table below.

Investigate added overhead above 3.5 minutes per shard: `(sum(new shard runtimes) - sum(baseline job runtimes)) / new shard count`. For a fixed-shard baseline, sum all original shards. Also report GPU-minutes using devices per job.


### Baselines

| Step | Build | Wall / total job min | GPU-min | Passed / skipped | Qualification |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `entrypoints-integration-api-server-openai-chat_completion` | [94543](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94543) | 30.7 / 30.7 | 30.7 | 373 / 5 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |
| `lm-eval-small-models-1xb200` | [94449](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94449) | 26.5 / 26.5 | 26.5 | 7 / 0 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |
| `lm-eval-large-models-4xh100` | [94449](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94449) | 24.4 / 24.4 | 97.7 | 2 / 0 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |
| `multi-modal-models-standard-2-qwen3-gemma` | [94543](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94543) | 34.9 / 34.9 | 34.9 | 17 / 0 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |
| `basic-models-tests-other` | [94543](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94543) | 27.2 / 27.2 | 27.2 | 464 / 27 | recording-free historical main; same job definition and hardware; commits differ |

Rows marked provisional lack a clean recent baseline; recording-free main controls are in [94583](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94583). Provisional comparisons must not be used to approve cost or coverage. Historical comparisons use the same hardware and job definitions but different commits. Queue time is excluded. Wall time is the maximum individual shard runtime, excluding staggered starts; it is not elapsed Buildkite time.

## Details

Duplicate check: inspected open CI/sharding PRs and excluded Fullgraph, MTEB, DFlash, Entrypoints LLM, multimodal extended generation, MoE refactor DP, and E2E Core work already covered elsewhere. Mamba source-build steps were excluded because every extra shard repeats expensive setup.

Uses existing ci-infra runtime sharding on main (`0b269fb2`); no generator changes are needed. Timing estimates exclude setup. The 12-hour ranking reports each old fixed shard separately, so it is prioritization evidence, not the total-runtime baseline.

AI assistance: Codex prepared the changes and local validation. No model or serving behavior is modified. Remote CI evidence and human review remain pending.

---

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

## Live validation results

Updated 2026-10-13 23:27 UTC. All five job groups completed; see outcomes and qualifications below.

| Step | State | Wall min (new / main) | Total job min (new / main) | GPU-min (new / main) | Added min/shard | Tests passed / skipped (new vs main) | Coverage |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| `entrypoints-integration-api-server-openai-chat_completion` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94559) | 16.5 / 30.7 | 31.3 / 30.7 | 31.3 / 30.7 | +0.28 | 373 / 5 vs 373 / 5 | matched; plugin verified |
| `lm-eval-small-models-1xb200` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94559) | 13.7 / 26.5 | 26.7 / 26.5 | 26.7 / 26.5 | +0.12 | 7 / 0 vs 7 / 0 | matched; plugin verified |
| `lm-eval-large-models-4xh100` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94559) | 21.1 / 24.4 | 26.3 / 24.4 | 105.0 / 97.7 | +0.92 | 2 / 0 vs 2 / 0 | matched; plugin verified |
| `multi-modal-models-standard-2-qwen3-gemma` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94559) | 17.1 / 34.9 | 31.0 / 34.9 | 31.0 / 34.9 | -1.95 | 17 / 0 vs 17 / 0 | matched; plugin verified |
| `basic-models-tests-other` | [passed](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/94559) | 16.3 / 27.2 | 26.8 / 27.2 | 26.8 / 27.2 | -0.19 | 464 / 27 vs 464 / 27 | matched; plugin verified |
